tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: Tokens tradable through the OneDex aggregator with USD price, verified/paused flags and approximate liquidity (OneDex + xExchange pools). Sorted by liquidity.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Quote a swap through the OneDex aggregator (XOXNO only if at least 1% better). Returns quotedOut, guaranteed minOut, route, price impact, a full `costs` breakdown, a one-line `costSummary` and warnings. Amounts are decimal strings plus raw base units.

tools.name: build_swap_tx
tools.description: Builds an UNSIGNED MultiversX swap transaction for `sender` to sign with its own wallet. The transaction is verified and rebuilt from verified fields only (receiver = hard-coded OneDex aggregator, or the allowlisted XOXNO router after strict route decoding, capped gas, gasPrice 1e9). tools.name: get_wallet_balances
tools.description: EGLD and fungible ESDT balances of an address (api.multiversx.com) with decimals and USD value when a price is known. Same source build_swap_tx uses for its balance warnings. Cached 10 s.

tools.name: simulate_swap_tx
tools.description: Dry-runs the UNSIGNED transaction returned by build_swap_tx on the MultiversX gateway (checkSignature=false). tools.name: tx_status
tools.description: Status of a transaction (pending / success / fail / not_found), finality (pending / notarized / final), actual fee paid (EGLD + USD), tokens the sender actually received, and the explorer link.
